## User Story

As a release operators delivering issues whose Scope embeds accepted requirements
I want to evaluate the formal acceptance criteria because embedded source headings currently shadow the governed checklist
So that false completion refusals and skipped verifier checks are prevented while approved requirements stay immutable

## Scope

- [x] Select the formal root `## Acceptance Criteria` for functional AC derivation and AC body-invariant checks when approved Scope embeds a lower-level AC heading.
- [x] Preserve requirement text, source offsets, proof markers and existing canonical body validation; retain supported legacy heading fallback when no canonical section exists.

## Reproduction

Run deriveAcsStatus on the actual restored ai-peer-review #144 public issue body containing an embedded `#### Acceptance Criteria` in Scope and one checked formal `## Acceptance Criteria`. It returns total=0, ticked=0, allTicked=false, sectionPresent=true instead of total=1/ticked=1/allTicked=true. No issue/source mutation is needed.

## Root Cause

functional-dod-evidence.mjs and both AC body-invariant finders select the first level-one-to-four heading through a raw regular expression. Embedded source headings therefore shadow the formal root AC section; ac-evidence already gives live canonical root headings precedence.

## Fix Direction

Use a small shared pure AC section locator for the affected functional/body-invariant readers, with canonical root heading precedence and the existing supported legacy fallback. Preserve all original bytes and section offsets, existing validation/refusal semantics, and proof marker interpretation.

## Out of Scope

APR #144 Scope/record/review/proofs, generic Markdown replacement, unrelated VC/DoD scanners, runtime/module patches, and changes to approval or evidence authority.

## Story Origin

**kind**: code
**discovered-during**: Governed ai-peer-review #144 delivery against delivered AITM e802e425.
**related**: Historical AITM #1897/#1899; ai-peer-review #144.
**blocks**: ai-peer-review #144 canonical AC derivation at Test-to-Review.
**provenance**: Confirmed during governed ai-peer-review #144 delivery. Exact delivered AITM e802e425d1d4efbc058c154d0f09b7b90116446c deriveAcsStatus returns zero ACs for actual restored #144 v102 despite its checked formal root AC. Private reproducible data and source receipt: .scratch/root-ac-intake/actual-consumer-reproduction.json. Historical #1897/#1899 fixed ac-evidence selection; this defect is its remaining functional derivation/body-invariant consumer seam. Full delivery repair authorization is established.

## Plan Metadata

**Implementation-plan**: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-06-1904-root-ac-consumers.md
**Verification-boundary**: Host affected/TIA only; full exact-head hosted CI through project verificationProvider.
